pages.text: An Agegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a green-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, the amount of time until nearby animals grow up will be significantly reduced, at the cost of charge for each animal affected.
To recharge a dun Agegleam, simply hold onto it. It regains one point of charge every three minutes.

$(bold)Gemcutter recipe$()$(br2)1 × arcanearchives:shaped_quartz$(br)4 × minecraft:green_dye$(br)9 × minecraft:wheat$(br)9 × minecraft:carrot$(br)9 × minecraft:wheat_seeds$(br2)Output: 1 × arcanearchives:agegleam
